PV01-q01-ydd35m: The rule is more than 10 persons including the driver; a vehicle for exactly 10 is not covered.
15 persons is the van test restriction number; the P rule is more than 10 persons, including the driver.
PV01-q02-u0v3g0: The Section 5 test depends on whether the bus has air brakes, not on testing in a van.
Testing in a small van restricts you to a 15-passenger-or-less small-size bus, not any bus.
PV01-q03-b7nywf: Paying riders are not allowed; a CLP holder may carry only auditors, inspectors, test examiners, other trainees, and the accompanying CDL holder.
Ordinary passengers are not allowed at all; 10 is the P endorsement size number, not a CLP passenger limit.
PV01-q04-339dfx: Your signature certifies the earlier defects were fixed, so sign only if they were certified repaired or not needing repair.
Too narrow: a report listing defects can be signed once they are certified repaired or as not needing repair.
PV01-q05-xk4hwi: Recapped tires are also banned on the front wheels, along with regrooved ones.
Tread depth does not matter; front wheels must have no recapped or regrooved tires.
PV01-q06-ebft2o: The handbook requires spare electrical fuses, not a spare battery, when a bus has no circuit breakers.
Fire extinguishers are required anyway; the item needed without circuit breakers is spare electrical fuses.
PV01-q07-afqlxj: You must close open access panels too, not just emergency exits, before driving.
Open access panels must be closed before driving, not after the first stop.
PV01-q08-k5f2cw: Counting seats is not the reason; people sometimes damage buses left unattended, which can hurt riders.
The interior check applies to all buses, because people sometimes damage buses left unattended.
PV01-q09-nved6e: Handholds and railings are on the interior checklist and must be in safe working order.
The restroom emergency buzzer is a signaling device on the interior checklist.
PV01-q10-0xhiuy: The light is not tied to the door being open; turn it on at night or whenever outside lights are on.
Not only in fog or rain; turn it on at night or any time you use your outside lights.
PV01-q11-ai0szf: Sharp-edged and cutting tools must go in a covered container, not loose under seats.
Riders do not hold them; in a farm labor vehicle, cutting or sharp-edged tools must be placed in a covered container.
PV01-q12-daf8ou: Too strict: some roof hatches may be locked partly open for fresh air.
Leaving hatches open as a regular practice is not allowed, even in hot weather.
PV01-q13-qdk5me: Letting the driver move freely and easily is one of the goals of securing baggage.
Letting riders get out by any window or door is one of the goals of securing baggage.
PV01-q14-rlzxy4: The numbers are swapped: there are 9 different labels, each 4 inches.
Hazard labels are diamond-shaped, not square.
PV01-q15-y985t0: Tear gas is never allowed on a bus, labeled or not.
Liquid Class 6 poison is on the never-carry list.
PV01-q16-6ll40h: 500 pounds is the total limit for all allowed HazMat; solid Class 6 poisons are capped at 100 pounds.
The no-other-way rule is for small amounts of other HazMat; solid Class 6 poisons are never over 100 pounds.
PV01-q17-ggcqn4: The limit is 500 pounds total, not per class; no single class may exceed 100 pounds.
100 pounds is the per-class limit; the total limit is 500 pounds.
PV01-q18-ke2qg6: Medically prescribed oxygen in the rider's possession, in a personal-use container, is allowed.
Small-arms ammunition labeled ORM-D is allowed; it is the exception to the explosives rule.
PV01-q19-x6n6of: Wrapping does not matter; riders may not carry on common hazards such as gasoline.
Where it rides does not matter; riders may not carry on common hazards such as gasoline.
PV01-q20-dkh9vk: Standing behind the standee line is where standees belong.
Toward the back of the bus is behind the driver's seat, so standing there is allowed.
PV01-q21-k9w6le: Location and reason for stopping are both on the list to announce.
Next departure time and bus number are both on the list to announce.
PV01-q22-o13bgd: Pets are not allowed, even in carriers; only certified service, guide, or signal dogs may ride.
Other riders' agreement does not matter; animals are prohibited except certified service, guide, or signal dogs.
